opening_message:
Ticket 1: Richard Davis (employee ID E011) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E011.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Richard Davis (E011) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. He requested write access to Payroll. Full-time employees may have up to write access; his role owns the Payroll system. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security record for E011 (Richard Davis) shows contractor with basic security training. Contractors without advanced training may have read at most; requested write exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: The employee's records conflict on employment type: the HR note lists full-time, but the Security record for E011 (Richard Davis) explicitly shows contractor with only basic security training. Contractors without advanced security training have a maximum access of read. The requested write access exceeds that maximum, so per policy the maximum (read) is granted.
